verification.reason: The change added a `/** ... */` block above `CheckRequestInput.packages` (check-request.ts:28). `CheckRequestInput` is not exported from packages/pipeline/src/index.ts. Only checks.ts, static-proof.ts and a test import it, by relative path. AGENTS.md:33 says "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals." The base file has no `packages` field, so the TSDoc is new. Sibling TSDoc blocks on the same type already existed at base, but that does not excuse the new one. The progress log for issue 454 shows the same type's `lang` field was converted to a line comment for this reason.

The finding's premise is false. packages/pipeline/src/index.ts lines 72-79 export `TypeScriptMutationAdapter` from "./mutation-enumeration.ts". `install()` is a public method of an exported class, so it is exported package API and the TSDoc on it is allowed under the "TSDoc only on exported package API" rule.
